tasks.label: PR Watcher (v2)
tasks.detail: Starts the v2 PR watcher via start-watcher.ps1 — pre-flights (main branch + clean tree + gh/claude on PATH), single-instance guard (refuses if another watcher is already running), and child-process reaping (kills only PIDs the watcher itself spawned; never Marco's interactive Claude sessions). Env defaults: AUTO_REVIEW=true, AUTO_UPDATE=true, AUTO_MERGE_POLICY=tests-docs, MAX_TURNS=240. Ctrl+C in the pane to stop.

tasks.label: branch: prune (local, dry-run)
tasks.detail: Prints a prune PLAN and deletes nothing. `git fetch --prune` first, which only drops stale remote-tracking refs and destroys no work; then branch-prune.ps1 in its default dry-run mode. This task previously chained a gone-upstream Select-String sweep into a force-delete loop, which removed every branch with a gone upstream regardless of unpushed commits, open PRs or worktrees — on 2026-09-03 one click would have destroyed the 28 commits on fix1483. That fall-through is gone and must not come back (a force-delete flag appearing in this file is itself the defect): deletion now requires running the script by hand with -Apply, which quarantines every branch to a ref before removing it. Windows PowerShell 5.1.
